feeds.title: Virtual Headache Specialist Blog

Virtual Headache Specialist is unique with a free interactive headache and facial pain symptom checker tool that simulates a visit with a headache specialist with questions they normally ask. It was created and run by an ABPN (American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology) certified neurologist and UCNS (United Council for Neurologic Subspecialties) certified Diplomat in Headache Medicine, working in a large academic medical institution.

This blog is to share what I learn as I stumble along. From info about meds and triggers to getting out of bed and not blaming yourself -- and everything else headache sufferers should know but are in too much pain to ask. There's still hope!
